title: Compare car insurance quotes from 120+ providers
content:
Whether you own a high-performance car, have invested in a prestige marque, or have settled on a topnotch hatchback or SUV to meet your family's needs, you're going to want an insurance policy that performs as well as your motor.
Of course, just because you want to ensure you have the best possible car insurance cover doesn't mean you should be forced to pay over the odds for that policy. And that's where we come in.
PistonHeads, the online home of true motoring enthusiasts, has teamed up with Quotezone.co.uk, one of the UK's leading car insurance comparison platforms, to help you find the right policy for your car at a price that won't break the bank.
Quotezone.co.uk are as passionate about cars as you are, and have been helping drivers just like you to find the right insurance at the right price for over 15 years. Their price comparison system enables you to compare quotes from over 100 insurance providers side by side, increasing your odds of finding cheap insurance for your high-end motor.
Simply visit Quotezone.co.uk, complete the short quote form, and your quotes will then be displayed on the screen, side by side.
Why compare car insurance with Quotezone.co.uk?
- Compare quotes from over 120 insurance providers in a matter of minutes
- See if you could save up to £518*
- Suitable whether you need to insure a high-performance car, a prestige car, a classic motor or a family vehicle
- Found a policy you like? Buy online or by phone
You could save up to £518*
*51% of consumers could save £518.14 on their Car Insurance. The saving was calculated by comparing the cheapest price found with the average of the next four cheapest prices quoted by insurance providers on Seopa Ltd’s insurance comparison website. This is based on representative cost savings from June 2025 data. The savings you could achieve are dependent on your individual circumstances and how you selected your current insurance supplier.
PistonHeads is an Introducer Appointed Representative of Seopa Limited who is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (Firm Reference Number 313860) and is classed as an insurance broker.
